title: Generalist- Human Resource I IND
description:
**Job Description**
**Basic Job Functions:**
Provides front line strategic human resource partnership as a junior-level HR Generalist for the India manufacturing site, ensuring all Human Resources functions and activities run effectively, efficiently, and in accordance with all applicable Vietnamese labor law and First Solar’s Core Values and Behaviors. Capable of successfully leading basic HR initiatives and analysis and participating in special projects as assigned.
  
  
**Experience:**

* At least 2 years progressive experience in Plant/Manufacturing Site Human Resources, required with Bachelor’s Degree
* Basic knowledge of the Labor Code and all relevant Vietnamese employment regulations, laws, and typical worker practices relevant to manufacturing environment required
* MNC experience, preferred

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s Degree required, with major in Human Resources, Business, or relevant discipline preferred

**Required Skills:**

* Business speaking and written fluency Tamil; English preferred
* Elementary employee relations / labor relations experience, as well as interpersonal and conflict management skills.
* Demonstrated project management capability to less complex program implementations.
* Demonstrates basic people management capability in terms of development, coaching,
* Deft ability to self-prioritize workload and effectively pivot in a fast-paced dynamic environment to drive effective results.
* System-savvy with hands-on mentality and global HRMS familiarity; Office suite proficiency required and Oracle HRMS preferred.
* Demonstrated analytical and presentation capabilities: data-driven, able to assess and articulate risks quickly, accurately, and effectively.
* Ability to effectively work with all levels and diversity of organizations and associates throughout the company.

**Essential Functions & Responsibilities**

* Manages recruitment activities to ensure that best-fit talent is identified for open roles with a hiring methodology that is sensible and process-adherent, includes:

+ Work with management and internal HR to identify and requisition appropriate headcount authorization
+ Coach manager through new/changed role development and facilitate internal HR/compensation processes
+ Lead talent source & search efforts and ensure a robust interview and selection process occurs to produce best-fit final candidate identification
+ Working within established processes and parameters, development of internally and externally balanced employment offer and coordination/production of jurisdiction-appropriate employment contract documents

* Facilitates onboarding activities for assigned organization, ensuring a successful company introduction to new hires as well as follow-on soft-skill training efforts; activities to include:

+ Direct facilitation of new hire documents and first-day support activities with pending hire, HRIS/Payroll, and local country administrative support
+ Conducting of the orientation sessions to include follow-on activities including SOX policies acknowledgement and post-orientation communications
+ On ongoing basis, participate in local development and delivery of soft-skill training content

* Actively partner with department leaders throughout the assigned organization to provide a one stop shop of HR support for current employment matters, including:

+ Coaching managers on broad variety of employee activities to bring them to successful outcomes
+ Develop and deliver value-add recommendations to the business on moderate to complex matters based on all applicable information sources to include employment law, best practice, and independent analysis
+ Conducting and documenting investigation activities and managing assigned level of employee relations activity such as employee complaints, supervisor/manager concerns regarding practice or policy application, and performance improvement/management matters
+ Aiding management of assigned population to make effective determinations regarding organizational alignment and headcount management, promotions, demotions, terminations & separations, etc.
+ Ensure HR strategic partnership alignment by attending customer group meetings and building key managerial relationships to achieve a working understanding of the business model, goals, and strategy

* Recommend improvements to, implement, deliver, and ensure the adherence to, HR processes, policies, frameworks, reports/documentation, requirements, and systems, to include activities like:

+ Preparation and delivery of analysis/costing
+ Development and execution of business proposals, reports, datasets
+ Scripting of process and program framework in partnership with applicable COEs
+ Communication rollout within HR group and to managers and employees to include appropriate level of self-service guidance and promotion
+ Audit and regular loopback to ensure policies are understood and lived by managers and employees and full compliance at all times with applicable regulations

* Other duties as assigned
* Job Description subject to change at any time

**Office Physical Requirements:**
All positions in our office require interaction with people and technology while either standing or sitting. In order to best service our customers, internal and external, all associates must be able to communicate face-to-face and on the phone with or without reasonable accommodation. First Solar is committed to compliance with its obligations under all applicable state and federal laws prohibiting employment discrimination. In keeping with this commitment, it attempts to reasonably accommodate applicants and employees in accordance with the requirements of the disability discrimination laws. It also invites individuals with disabilities to participate in a good faith, interactive process to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made without imposing an undue hardship.

title: Human Resources Executive

title: Generalist- Human Resource II IND
description:
**Job Description**
**Basic Job Functions:**
The Human Resources Generalist manages the day-to-day operations of the Human Resource Department. The HR Generalist manages the administration of the human resources policies, procedures and programs. The HR Generalist carries out responsibilities in the following functional areas: departmental development, Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS), employee relations, training and development, benefits, compensation, organizational development, and employment.
  
  
**Education and Experience:**




+ Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Human Resources, Business, or Organization Development with supplemental course works in Human Resources or field. Master’s degree in Human resource will be an added advantage.



+ Six to eight years of progressive experience in Human Resources generalist roles in Manufacturing Sector.



+ Specialized training in employment law, compensation, organizational planning, organizational development, employee relations and safety training, preferred.

**Required Skills/Competencies:**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills required.
  
  

+ Knowledge of employment laws and practices.



+ Knowledge of the basic principles and practices of public human resources administration including recruitment, classification, compensation and benefits.



+ Knowledge of the methods and practices of sound records management.



+ Knowledge of the literature and other sources of information in the field of human resources administration.
+ Knowledge of basic statistical concepts and methods.



+ Ability to prepare and maintain records.



+ Evidence of the practice of a high level of confidentiality. Ability to maintain confidential information.



+ Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional documents, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.



+ Ability to write reports and routine business correspondence.



+ Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, employees, customers, and the general public.



+ Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exits.



+ Ability to interpret of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.



+ Ability to make decisions in accordance with laws, ordinances, regulations and established policies.



+ Ability to deal tactfully and courteously with employees at all levels and the general public.



+ While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to use a fax, calculator, and copy machine.



+ While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to use a computer. Good knowledge of PC operations and software (Word processing, database and spreadsheet) are required. Good typing skills are also required.

**Essential Responsibilities:**




+ Develops and creates the Human Resources Department functions & responsibilities .



+ Participates in the development of policy and documentation.



+ Development and administration of programs, procedures, and guidelines to help align the workforce with the strategic goals of the company.



+ Participates in developing goals, objectives, and systems.



+ Participates in administrative staff meeting and attends other meetings.



+ Assists to establish departmental measurements that support the accomplishment of the company’s strategic goals.



+ Assists with the monitoring of an annual budget.



+ Manages the development and maintenance of the Human Resources sections of both the Internet, particularly recruiting, culture, and company information, and Intranet sites



+ Maintains employee-related databases. Prepares and analyzes reports that are necessary to carry out the functions of the department and office. Prepares periodic reports for management, as necessary or requested.



+ Maintains records on sick leave, vacation and other absences.



+ Recommends, develops and maintains human resources databases, computer software systems and manual filing systems.

**Reporting Relationships:**

* No direct reports.

**Travel:**

* Travel is required whenever needs & requirements arises.

*Potential candidates will meet the education and experience requirements provided on the above job description and excel in completing the listed responsibilities for this role. All candidates receiving an offer of employment must successfully complete a background check band any other tests that may be required.*

It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that diversity and inclusion is a driving force in the success of our company.*

title: Manager - IR & Admin
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Statutory Approvals – Project & Construction Phase

Coordinate and obtain applicable approvals from DTCP/competent planning authorities, TANGEDCO/TNEB, TNPCB and other relevant government departments.
  
  
Coordinate factory building approvals, factory plan approvals, factory license and other applicable permissions in consultation with the concerned departments.
  
  
Ensure applicable statutory requirements relating to land use, building construction, electrical installations, fire safety, environmental compliance and occupational safety are addressed.
  
  
Coordinate with Civil, Electrical, EHS, Projects and external consultants to secure approvals before commencement of relevant activities.
  
  
Track approval timelines, dependencies and critical-path activities to avoid delays in construction and commissioning.
  
  

* Factory Operational Compliance

Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, factory legislation, industrial relations requirements, environmental regulations and other statutory obligations.
  
  
Coordinate applicable registrations, licenses, renewals, periodic returns, inspections and statutory submissions.
  
  
Maintain a statutory compliance calendar and proactively monitor due dates, validity periods and regulatory changes.
  
  
Coordinate statutory inspections, audits, notices and correspondence with government authorities and ensure timely closure of observations.
  
  
Maintain statutory registers, records, certificates, approvals and supporting documentation for audits and inspections.
  
  

* Industrial Relations & Contract Labour Management

Coordinate contract labour compliance, contractor documentation, labour license requirements, applicable registrations and statutory records.
  
  
Ensure compliance with applicable wage, social security, employment and other labour-related requirements.
  
  
Support workforce-related IR matters, contractor coordination, employee welfare and grievance resolution as required.
  
  

* Administration & Stakeholder Coordination

Act as the single point of contact for statutory and regulatory matters relating to the new facility.
  
  
Manage external statutory consultants and coordinate with internal functions for timely submission of documents and closure of requirements.
  
  
Establish a structured compliance tracker, responsibility matrix and periodic review mechanism.
  
  
Provide periodic updates to management on approval status, pending actions, compliance risks and mitigation plans.
  
  
**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
Timely completion of applicable statutory approvals as per the project schedule.
  
  
All required licenses and permissions in place before the relevant construction, commissioning or operational activities.
  
  
100% timely completion of applicable statutory returns, renewals and submissions.
  
  
Zero avoidable statutory non-compliances, penalties or production interruptions attributable to compliance failures.
  
  
Timely closure of statutory inspection observations and audit findings.

title: Senior Associate - Resource Management
description:
**Position Summary**
 The Senior Associate, Resource Management supports staffing, scheduling, capacity planning, workforce analytics, and resource optimization activities for the India Tax practice. This role works closely with the Manager, Talent Optimization and Tax leadership to facilitate effective resource deployment, monitor capacity and utilization, support staffing decisions, and maintain accurate workforce data.
   

  

 The Senior Associate serves as a key contributor to workforce planning efforts by providing reporting, analysis, and operational support to help ensure resources are aligned with business demands while supporting employee development, engagement objectives, and operational excellence across U.S. and India teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Scheduling \& Staffing Support**
* Support the scheduling of tax professionals across multiple industries within the India Tax team.
* Assist with processing staffing requests and ensuring schedules remain accurate, current, and aligned with business needs.
* Monitor resource availability, capacity, PTO, training, and other scheduling commitments.
* Identify potential scheduling conflicts, capacity constraints, or workload imbalances and communicate findings to the Manager, Talent Optimization.
* Assist with work transitions, reassignments, and workload balancing activities as directed.
* Maintain accurate staffing information in scheduling tools, trackers, reports, and workforce planning systems.


**Capacity, Utilization \& Workforce Analytics**
* Prepare and analyze capacity, utilization, staffing, and availability reports for leadership review.
* Track employee availability, chargeable hour projections, and scheduled commitments to support workforce visibility.
* Monitor schedule changes and ensure updates are reflected in timely reporting systems.
* Identify trends in staffing, utilization, and resource availability and communicate insights to support decision\-making.
* Support data validation efforts to improve reporting accuracy, workforce visibility, and data integrity.
* Assist in workforce planning activities by monitoring forecasted workload, resource demand, and skill requirements.
* Provide scheduling, utilization, and capacity\-related information as requested by management.


**Coordination \& Stakeholder Communication**
* Serve as a resource for routine scheduling inquiries from team members, managers, and engagement teams.
* Coordinate with U.S. and India Tax teams to gather staffing information, scheduling updates, and resource needs.
* Build effective working relationships with U.S. and India leadership teams to support resource deployment decisions.
* Facilitate communication regarding staffing conflicts, priorities, workload balancing, and schedule changes.
* Escalate staffing concerns, scheduling issues, or capacity risks to the Manager, Talent Optimization when appropriate.


**Process \& Administrative Support**
* Follow established scheduling procedures, guidelines, and best practices.
* Assist with maintaining scheduling documentation, process materials, and training resources.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance scheduling efficiency, reporting quality, and data accuracy.
* Participate in team meetings, scheduling calls, capacity review exercises, and workforce planning discussions.
* Assist with onboarding and training activities related to scheduling tools, reporting processes, and resource management procedures.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in business, Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Operations, or related fields.
* 2\-4 years of experience in resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, professional services operations, project coordination, or related discipline.
* Experience in a CPA firm, tax practice, public accounting, or professional services environment preferred.
* Strong Excel and reporting skills, including pivot tables, data analysis, and report preparation.
* Experience with resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, ERP, or reporting platforms; Microsoft Dynamics or similar systems preferred.
* Excellent attention to detail, organization, critical thinking, and follow\-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate across teams and levels.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and shift business needs in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify issues, summarize findings, and support practical solutions.


**Core Competencies**
 Resource Coordination
   

  

 Relationship Management
   

  

 Schedule Management
   

  

 Problem Solving
   

  

 Capacity Planning \& Tracking
   

  

 Business Acumen
   

  

 Workforce Analytics
   

  

 Time Management
   

  

 Operational Support
   

  

 Attention to Detail
   

  

 Data Accuracy \& Reporting
   

  

 Adaptability
   

  

**Success Measures**
* Accuracy and integrity of staffing, scheduling, and workforce planning data.
* Timely and effective processing of staffing requests and schedule updates.
* Quality, reliability, and usefulness of capacity, utilization, and availability reporting.
* Proactive identification and communication of capacity constraints, staffing risks, and workload imbalances.
* Responsiveness to scheduling inquiries and ability to support timely decision\-making.
* Effective support of workload balancing, resource deployment, and staffing processes across U.S. and India teams.
* Positive stakeholder feedback from leadership, managers, and engagement teams.
* Contribution to improved scheduling efficiency, utilization of visibility, and resource management processes.
